list.name: LoadId
list.query: select distinct LoadId from TestLoad order by LoadId desc

panels.title: Como leer este dashboard
panels.description: Guia ejecutiva y operativa para interpretar gobierno enterprise, evidencia y riesgos.

options.content: Que muestra: inventario tecnologico, lifecycle, compliance y confianza de monitoreo por lote. Como interpretarlo: evidencia faltante o desconocida requiere accion. Accion sugerida: resolver brechas de inventario antes de aceptar riesgo como controlado.

panels.title: Semaforo Inventario
panels.description: Porcentaje de componentes con inventario minimo completo: host, tipo, dominio, subsistema y owner. Rojo <60%, amarillo 60-84.99%, verde >=85%.

targets.rawSql: with Conteo as (select count(*) filter (where nullif(ComponentName,'') is not null and nullif(TechnologyType,'') is not null and nullif(DomainName,'') is not null and nullif(BusinessServiceId,'') is not null and nullif(Owner,'') is not null) as OkCount, count(*) as TotalCount from EnterpriseTechnologyComponent where LoadId ~ '^(${LoadId:regex})') select coalesce(round(100.0 * OkCount / nullif(TotalCount, 0), 2), 0) as InventarioPct, '[' || OkCount || '/' || TotalCount || ']' as InventarioDetalle from Conteo

panels.title: Semaforo Ciclo de Vida / Compliance
panels.description: Porcentaje de componentes sin backlevel, sin fin de soporte y con compliance/licencia compliant. Rojo <60%, amarillo 60-84.99%, verde >=85%.

targets.rawSql: with Conteo as (select count(*) filter (where LifecycleStatus in ('Supported','Current') and SupportStatus not in ('EndOfSupport','EndOfLife','Backlevel','Unknown') and ComplianceStatus = 'Compliant' and LicenseStatus = 'Compliant' and BacklevelStatus = 'Current') as OkCount, count(*) as TotalCount from EnterpriseTechnologyComponent where LoadId ~ '^(${LoadId:regex})') select coalesce(round(100.0 * OkCount / nullif(TotalCount, 0), 2), 0) as CicloVidaCompliancePct, '[' || OkCount || '/' || TotalCount || ']' as CicloVidaComplianceDetalle from Conteo

panels.title: Semaforo Confianza de Monitoreo
panels.description: Porcentaje de evidencias disponibles y frescas. La evidencia faltante, desconocida, incompleta o no verificada reduce la confianza. Rojo <60%, amarillo 60-84.99%, verde >=85%.

targets.rawSql: with Conteo as (select count(*) filter (where EvidenceState = 'Available' and FreshnessStatus = 'Fresh') as OkCount, count(*) as TotalCount from EnterpriseEvidenceRecord where LoadId ~ '^(${LoadId:regex})') select coalesce(round(100.0 * OkCount / nullif(TotalCount, 0), 2), 0) as ConfianzaMonitoreoPct, '[' || OkCount || '/' || TotalCount || ']' as ConfianzaMonitoreoDetalle from Conteo

panels.title: Inventario Tecnologico
panels.description: Componentes gobernados con dominio, servicio, owner, lifecycle y estado de evidencia.

targets.rawSql: select ComponentName as HostName, TechnologyType, DomainName, BusinessServiceId, Owner, SupportStatus, LifecycleStatus, EvidenceState from EnterpriseTechnologyComponent where LoadId ~ '^(${LoadId:regex})' order by ComponentName

panels.title: Lifecycle y Compliance
panels.description: Riesgos de ciclo de vida y cumplimiento por componente y servicio afectado.

targets.rawSql: select c.ComponentName as HostName, c.SupportStatus, c.LifecycleStatus, r.RiskCategory, r.Severity, r.Impact, r.RecommendedAction from EnterpriseTechnologyComponent c left join EnterpriseRiskRegistryEntry r on r.AffectedTechnologyId = c.ComponentId where c.LoadId ~ '^(${LoadId:regex})' and coalesce(r.RiskCategory,'') in ('Lifecycle','Compliance','') order by c.ComponentName

panels.title: Confianza de Monitoreo
panels.description: Estado de evidencia por fuente, frescura y componente para auditar cobertura de monitoreo.

targets.rawSql: select e.SourceSystem, c.ComponentName as HostName, e.EvidenceType, e.FreshnessStatus, e.EvidenceState, e.EvidenceReference from EnterpriseEvidenceRecord e left join EnterpriseTechnologyComponent c on c.ComponentId = e.ComponentId where e.LoadId ~ '^(${LoadId:regex})' order by e.EvidenceState, c.ComponentName
